argv:
export MC_BACKUP_DSN="$MC_TEST_DATABASE_URL"
export MC_BACKUP_RETAIN=2
export MC_BACKUP_PG_DUMP=/private/tmp/mc-opencode-verify-wave-20261031/backup-bin/pg_dump
export MC_BACKUP_PG_RESTORE=/private/tmp/mc-opencode-verify-wave-20261031/backup-bin/pg_restore
probe() {
  d="$1"; label="$2"
  echo "== $label dir=$d"
  echo "-- before: $(ls -1 "$d"/mcapi-*.dump 2>/dev/null | wc -l) dump(s)"
  MC_BACKUP_DIR="$d" bash ./scheduled-dump.sh; echo "exit=$?"
  echo "-- after: $(ls -1 "$d"/mcapi-*.dump 2>/dev/null | wc -l) dump(s), $(ls -1 "$d"/mcapi-*.dump.sha256 2>/dev/null | wc -l) sidecar(s)"
  ls -1 "$d" | sort | tail -12
}
probe /private/tmp/mc-opencode-verify-wave-20261031/probe-empty empty-dir
probe /private/tmp/mc-opencode-verify-wave-20261031/probe-stale four-old-dumps
